The test strips chosen for this study measured 25 mm long 400 lm wide, a width
which was found experimentally to provide an optimum combination of heat transfer data and bubble visualization.

The 400-lm test strip was selected for boiling tests due to its
lower spreading heat loss than the 100-lm test strip and clearer
visualizations than the 1600-lm test strip.

Complete 3D maps of each test strip measuring
25 mm 400 lm were obtained with a Zygo Newview 6200
white-light optical interferometer at 50 magnification.

Power-controlled boiling curves with decreasing heat input are
reported in this work, including 13-14 data points collected for
each test surface.
